On the one hand, Tufan has Sword Mastery for Deck Battling (So does Io, but she's going to mainly be a surgeon in PvP, so it's obviously not going to be active), but on the other, Wolfgang has a (very) slightly faster skill unlock than Tufan and a Correspondence that I will very probably be abusing. (bashes head against the wall)

comments.body:
I'd just like to let you know that both cargo organization and windbreak and rather useless skills...
For windbreak it's marely a matter of readjusting your route while sailing and cargo toppling.. I lose like 2 - 3 cargo very *infrequently* when a storm happens.

Tufan also has arabic and turkish while wolfgang has english...
I'd say dont bother too much with skills that are in jobs you'll (almost) never use; consider more on the skills of the aide job you'll put him in
